title: DecisionRecord
description: Typed artifact produced by the supplier-risk agent for one decision-augmented query. Closes the user-flagged decision-augmented-RAG gap with a recoverable artifact: every query that asks 'what should I do about supplier X?' produces one of these, signed by evidence pointers + a rule id.

id.description: UUIDv4 of the decision record; unique per produced artifact.

query.description: The natural-language decision query the agent answered.

status.description: supported: evidence backed the decision. insufficient_evidence: retrieval succeeded but evidence didn't pass the supporting-claim test. refused: the agent declined to decide (e.g. out-of-scope query, refusal rule triggered).

rule_id.description: Identifier of the decision rule that produced this verdict. The rule registry is in src/agent/decision_rules.py.

evidence_pointers.description: Verbatim citations that support the verdict. Empty array is required when status != supported; non-empty when status == supported.

span_text.description: The exact substring verified verbatim against the source chunk.

span_offsets.description: [start, end) byte offsets within the source chunk.

confidence.description: Agent-side confidence in the verdict. Calibration is a follow-up — for v1 this is the rule's own confidence score.

produced_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the decision was recorded.

model.description: LLM provider:model the agent ran on (optional for rule-only decisions).

notes.description: Optional free-text note for the reviewer.
